text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi and Yemeni counterpart Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani chair Syrian-Yemeni committee and discuss cooperation in all fields. Yemen expresses support to Syria's role in the peace process.
- Syrian Vice President Abdul-Halim Khaddam discuss with a visiting Algerian delegation the Arab-Israeli struggle and Syrian-Algerian relations.
- Trade between Syria and Yemen was around 100 million Syrian pounds ($2 million).
- Syria has marketed 112,000 tonnes of cotton from the 1995/1996 season.
- Israel renews rejection of European role in Middle East peace process. Paris and Moscow stress need to resume peace talks respect to land-for-peace principle.
- First U.N Secretary General was an Israeli intelligence agent.
- Syria to start exporting wheat to Algeria.
